articles.title: Russell Brand is being investigated over two new rape complaints, police say
articles.summary: Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Russell Brand is being investigated over two new rape complaints, police say
articles.summaryTr: Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.
articles.articleText: Russell Brand is being investigated over two new rape complaints, police say - Published Warning: Details of rape and sexual assault Russell Brand is being investigated over rape allegations made by two more women, it can now be reported. The disgraced comedian has been found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault by a jury of eight men and four women at Southwark Crown Court, following a three-week trial. More victims are likely to come forward following his conviction, the detective who led the police investigation has said. Det Supt Andy Furphy, from the Metropolitan Police, said he hoped other women would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts. Brand was found not guilty of two counts of rape and one count of attempted indecent assault. 'Ruthless' Brand had initially been coy and quiet in police interviews, said Furphy, but became bolder as officers continued to question him. "As he gets used to something, he becomes more emboldened by it," Furphy said. "You can certainly see that in his offending." Hundreds of people were interviewed as part of the investigation and officers said several witnesses came forward, some of whom had previously had a sexual relationship with Brand. Katy Perry, the US singer who was married to Brand from 2010 to 2012, was not interviewed. Brand, 51, who was described in court as "ruthless" and a "sexual predator", was once one of the UK's most high-profile and in-demand entertainers. Some of the women said they had been left "haunted for years" by what he did to them. Speaking to the BBC, officers working on the three-year Metropolitan Police investigation described how bringing Brand to justice was not without its challenges. Allegations about Brand's behaviour first emerged in the media in September 2023. The Times, Sunday Times and Channel 4's Dispatches programme jointly reported that four women had accused him of rape, sexual assault and emotional abuse - claims he strongly denied. The investigation into other reports against Brand began soon after the story broke. "We kind of assumed that people might want to come forward," Furphy said, "and people came forward." Victim reports were made to forces across the country and the Met set up a dedicated team of officers to lead the investigation, which it called Operation Actinolite. Officers said they have since taken more than 340 witness statements - including from Brand's former employers, his ex-colleagues and associates. One officer was assigned to read Brand's books, watch his stand-up routines and DVDs and listen to his podcasts to help build the case. Brand's high profile and the intense media scrutiny around him proved a challenge to officers, said Furphy. Another complexity for the team was the allegations were all "non-recent". The earliest dated back 27 years. It meant there was no CCTV and no forensic evidence to work with. Furphy said police had to look for other ways to build their case. "Can we look at where the victims were at the time? Who did they speak to in the aftermath of it? Did they tell anybody else? What other available material is there for us to review that might lend some weight to it? Just because it's non-recent doesn't mean that we can't solve it at all." A former friend of Brand's was called to court to give evidence for the prosecution, while a statement from the parents of one of the women was heard. The entertainer's former personal assistant, who worked closely with Brand, told the jury about his "insane sexual appetite". 'Deeply uncomfortable' process Two months after the police investigation began, Brand was interviewed under caution for the first time. He was interviewed on two further occasions in the following months. In each interview he provided officers with a prepared statement, which said he did not recognise the complainants or recall the alleged incidents and that if any sexual activity had taken place, it would have been consensual. He then answered "no comment" to the officers' questions. Charges were brought against Brand in early April 2025: one count of rape, one count of oral rape, two charges of sexual assault and one allegation of indecent assault. The final charge would later be changed to attempted indecent assault at his trial. The charges all related to women who had come forward since the initial Channel 4 documentary. The following month he appeared at Westminster Magistrates' Court, in London. He was swarmed by camera crews, so much so that it took him more than two minutes to walk the short distance to the court door. At a later court hearing he pleaded not guilty to the charges. Meanwhile, women continued to come forward with more allegations. In July 2025, Brand was interviewed for a fourth time before being charged with further offences: one count of rape and one count of sexual assault. He also denied those allegations. And then on 14 October 2026, accompanied by his wife Laura, the actor and comedian entered the glass dock at London's Southwark Crown Court for the start of his trial. The women each came to court and gave evidence to the jury from behind a screen, with Brand listening from the dock. At times they cried as they gave their evidence. Furphy believes there may be more women who will now come forward. "I think it's likely - potentially - that other women will come forward," he said. "They'll probably gain some courage and some confidence from what's happened in the courtroom over the last few weeks." He credits the women for their bravery during what has been at times a "deeply uncomfortable" process. "They are courageous, determined women and our focus has always been on them, not Russell Brand." articles.title: Drunk and dangerous e-bike riders face on-the-spot fines under crackdown
articles.summary: A consultation will consider fines and other ways to clamp down on dangerous e-bike riders.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Drunk and dangerous e-bike riders face on-the-spot fines under crackdown
articles.summaryTr: A consultation will consider fines and other ways to clamp down on dangerous e-bike riders.
articles.articleText: Drunk and dangerous e-bike riders face on-the-spot fines under crackdown - Published People riding drunk or dangerously on e-bikes – and those who jump red lights - could face on-the-spot fines under plans to curb anti-social behaviour. Firms which run shared e-bike schemes will also be expected to manage their fleets better and provide designated parking areas to keep pavements safe. They could also be required to take out insurance so people can claim compensation if they are hit by someone on a shared bike. It's part of a crackdown on what ministers called the "wild west" of e-biking – with a patchwork of rules across the country often leaving the streets unsafe for pedestrians. A consultation launched on Thursday sets out proposed national standards to make journeys safer for everyone and keep pavements clear, particularly for wheelchair users and families with prams. The first e-bikes were launched in Exeter in 2016 and arrived in London a year later, growing to become a popular commuter option. According to the Greater London Authority, 37 million trips were taken on dockless e-bikes last year – a third more than the previous year. Shared e-bikes - such as Lime, Voi, Beryl, Dott, Forest and Bolt - make short journeys quick and convenient. While some areas enforce rules that mean shared bikes can only be left in specific areas, others have looser rules. Under the government's proposals, local leaders will be able to license schemes in their area, allowing them to enforce minimum standards and better integrate e-bikes into existing transport networks. Measures could include requiring operators to have a parking plan and to manage fleet sizes and operating areas, so bikes aren't overcrowding streets. The consultation will also consider ways to tackle antisocial and illegal behaviour, to prevent users from riding shared cycles drunk, underage, or on pavements. There will also be clear consequences set out – such as fines - for this type of behaviour. The government is also consulting on whether local leaders should have extra powers, including setting fees and requirements for operators to share data to improve enforcement and journey planning. The consultation will last for eight weeks after which the government will draw up legislation to implement the changes. - 'Dumped e-scooters force blind people into road' - Published1 April - Red light jumping cyclists offered film over fine - Published14 October - 'Our lives will never be the same again after Lime bike crash' - Published29 June Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the e-bike clampdown was a "small but important everyday fix" which would make streets safer. Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander said the government wanted e-bike schemes to "grow in popularity" but acknowledged they were "causing a little bit of nuisance at the moment". Asked how punishments for dangerous cycling could be enforced, Alexander said licensing rules could allow for fines but added: "What you can't do is legislate for every eventuality, you can't legislate for idiots." "The police enforce the rules of the road to stop cyclists when they are behaving recklessly but police have got a lot on their plate so individuals have to take some responsibility," she added. Bosses at Lime, Voi and Bolt all welcomed the proposals, adding that consistent standards being applied across the country would provide clarity and certainty for operators, riders and the general public. Mike Wordingham from the Royal National Institute for the Blind said 92% of blind and partially sighted people had been forced to walk into roads due to e-bikes blocking pavements. He welcomed the government's announced but warned that tackling rider behaviour would be "difficult" and said a locally-led approach shouldn't lead to "a patchwork of regulations and inconsistency in implementing them". articles.title: Why do veterinary fees and sausage rolls vary in price across London?
articles.summary: Location is not just the only factor on why prices differ across London, as Anna O'Neill finds out.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Why do veterinary fees and sausage rolls vary in price across London?
articles.summaryTr: Location is not just the only factor on why prices differ across London, as Anna O'Neill finds out.
articles.articleText: Why do veterinary fees and sausage rolls vary in price across London? - Published Have you ever wondered why the same item costs more or less depending on where in London you buy it? Take a bog standard Greggs’ sausage roll for example. If you buy it in an outer London borough like Sutton, it costs £1.35. But if you buy it in central London you're likely to pay £1.60. You might have guessed that the price difference, according to Greggs, is often about location. "We use national pricing across most of our shops however, this can vary in certain locations where costs are higher than average, such as travel hubs," they told the BBC in a statement. So far so obvious perhaps. What about going out for pizza? You might think the price of a pizza at the same chain would be the same wherever in London you eat it. Not necessarily. A Duo Romana pizza from Pizza Express costs £20.95 in Muswell Hill, north London. But three miles (5km) further north in Southgate, the same pizza at Pizza Express costs a pound more. And in central London the same pizza will set you back £22.95. Pizza Express was asked for comment but did not respond. Consumer expert Helen Dewdney from the Complaining Cow, external website says that as well as higher costs in central London, the price difference can also be due to how convenient it is to get to the restaurant. Southgate has a Tube station, Muswell Hill does not. "It’s all about cashing in on convenience for people. "One will be nearer a Tube, so they’re counting on people saying 'Oh, I'll just get a pizza on the way home'. "Whereas another you might have to make a journey to it." Other examples of cross-borough price variations include: - A Vue cinema ticket bought online costs £6.99 in Eltham, but £9.99 in Piccadilly or Angel, Islington - A blow dry at Rush hair salon costs from £45 in Kentish Town, north London but £40 in Ilford, east London - Fish, chips and a drink in Wetherspoons in Sidcup, south-east London costs £11.18 but the same meal in Camden Town, north London costs £12.77. Also, petrol prices can vary from pump to pump at the same company and within as little as a mile (1.5km) radius. A recent example from EG On the Move on the same day in London found these price variations: - Unleaded (E10): 171.9p – 177.9p per litre - Diesel (B7): 198.2p – 201.9p. Other forecourts also charge more or less if they are near a main road or a motorway or part of a supermarket for example. For this Dewdney recommends downloading a price comparison app like petrolprices.com, external "You can look at the distance as well as the price difference so you’re not driving too far away," she explained. "It’s not always the nearest one that’s worth going to." Vet bills are another example. Recent changes to legislation mean that vets must publish a comprehensive price list for standard services but it does not necessarily follow that vets in a different practice at the same chain will have the same prices. Vets for Pets in Pets At Home is a case in point. In Pets At Home in Chingford, east London the Vets for Pets practice charges £136 for a rabbit castration including two follow-up consultations. The same treatment at Vets For Pets in Pets At Home in Enfield, north London costs £70. Dewdney admits being surprised that the price can almost double from one practice to another. "I think it's an interesting one, because... they can set their own prices. "Although the government did bring in some changes for vets, it wasn't about capping the prices. It was just that they had to be more transparent," she explained. Pets At Home said: "Vets for Pets practices are independently owned and operated, with practice owners having full clinical and day-to-day operational autonomy, including setting fees for delivering the high-quality care and services they provide. "Pricing decisions are made locally and vary for many reasons including factors such as operating costs, staffing, facilities and the unique needs of the communities they serve. "All costs are communicated clearly with clients ahead of any treatment or service being provided." The company also said that veterinary practices had, like many businesses across the UK "experienced increased operating costs over the past year, including rises in energy, wages, medicines and other essential supplies". It added: "These pressures are felt right across the sector, but practice teams work hard to keep costs as low as possible to ensure high-quality care is accessible and affordable for pet owners in their local communities." So what is the moral of the story? Perhaps to shop around, and not to assume that prices at the same chain will be the same wherever you go, whether that be for veterinary care, your weekly shop, having your hair done or filling up the car. Price comparison websites can be a useful tool, and it is worth remembering that just because goods may be from the same restaurant, supermarket or petrol station in a different area, prices may well vary. Or as Dewdney summed up: "People have just got to do their research." Additional reporting by Rita Monjardino Listen to the best of BBC Radio London on Sounds and follow BBC London on Facebook, external, X, external and Instagram, external. "One will be nearer a Tube, so they’re counting on people saying 'Oh, I'll just get a pizza on the way home'. "Whereas another you might have to make a journey to it." Other examples of cross-borough price variations include: - A Vue cinema ticket bought online costs £6.99 in Eltham, but £9.99 in Piccadilly or Angel, Islington - A blow dry at Rush hair salon costs from £45 in Kentish Town, north London but £40 in Ilford, east London - Fish, chips and a drink in Wetherspoons in Sidcup, south-east London costs £11.18 but the same meal in Camden Town, north London costs £12.77. Also, petrol prices can vary from pump to pump at the same company and within as little as a mile (1.5km) radius. A recent example from EG On the Move on the same day in London found these price variations: - Unleaded (E10): 171.9p – 177.9p per litre - Diesel (B7): 198.2p – 201.9p. Other forecourts also charge more or less if they are near a main road or a motorway or part of a supermarket for example. For this Dewdney recommends downloading a price comparison app like petrolprices.com, external "You can look at the distance as well as the price difference so you’re not driving too far away," she explained. "It’s not always the nearest one that’s worth going to." Vet bills are another example. Recent changes to legislation mean that vets must publish a comprehensive price list for standard services but it does not necessarily follow that vets in a different practice at the same chain will have the same prices. Vets for Pets in Pets At Home is a case in point. In Pets At Home in Chingford, east London the Vets for Pets practice charges £136 for a rabbit castration including two follow-up consultations. The same treatment at Vets For Pets in Pets At Home in Enfield, north London costs £70. Dewdney admits being surprised that the price can almost double from one practice to another. "I think it's an interesting one, because... they can set their own prices. "Although the government did bring in some changes for vets, it wasn't about capping the prices. It was just that they had to be more transparent," she explained. Pets At Home said: "Vets for Pets practices are independently owned and operated, with practice owners having full clinical and day-to-day operational autonomy, including setting fees for delivering the high-quality care and services they provide. "Pricing decisions are made locally and vary for many reasons including factors such as operating costs, staffing, facilities and the unique needs of the communities they serve. "All costs are communicated clearly with clients ahead of any treatment or service being provided." The company also said that veterinary practices had, like many businesses across the UK "experienced increased operating costs over the past year, including rises in energy, wages, medicines and other essential supplies". It added: "These pressures are felt right across the sector, but practice teams work hard to keep costs as low as possible to ensure high-quality care is accessible and affordable for pet owners in their local communities." So what is the moral of the story? Perhaps to shop around, and not to assume that prices at the same chain will be the same wherever you go, whether that be for veterinary care, your weekly shop, having your hair done or filling up the car. Price comparison websites can be a useful tool, and it is worth remembering that just because goods may be from the same restaurant, supermarket or petrol station in a different area, prices may well vary. Or as Dewdney summed up: "People have just got to do their research." articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
articles.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
articles.articleText: Release Number 9314-26 CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball October 26, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the National Basketball Association today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to protect the integrity of professional basketball in prediction markets. Through the MOU, the CFTC and NBA will better share information by regularly communicating and discussing matters relating to integrity, as well as maintaining fair and transparent prediction markets. “I’m pleased the CFTC and NBA signed an MOU which continues the Commission’s commitment to increasing data sharing between the agency and professional sports leagues,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The NBA joins the MLB and NHL in taking a responsible step toward protecting sports integrity and market participants from abuses in prediction markets like insider trading and fraud. I thank NBA Commissioner Adam Silver for putting the integrity of professional basketball and America’s financial markets first and for working with the CFTC on this MOU.” -CFTC-

news.articleText: Bitcoin 76 bin doların altına geriledi! Kripto piyasasında sert satış dalgası - ABD borsalarında teknoloji hisseleri öncülüğünde yaşanan sert satış dalgası kripto para piyasasını da vurdu. Bitcoin gün içinde 76 bin doların altını görürken, küresel kripto para piyasasının toplam değeri 24 saatte 108 milyar dolardan fazla azaldı. CoinMarketCap verilerine göre, küresel kripto para piyasasının toplam değeri son 24 saatte yüzde 4,22 düşerek 2,56 trilyon dolara geriledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Piyasanın en büyük kripto para birimi Bitcoin, son 24 saatte yüzde 4,6 değer kaybederken haftalık kaybı da yüzde 5'i aştı. Gün içinde 76 bin doların altına gerileyen Bitcoin, TSİ 23.00 itibarıyla 76 bin 241 dolardan işlem gördü. Altcoin piyasasında da satış baskısı etkili oldu. Ethereum'un fiyatı son 24 saatte yüzde 6,1 düşerek 2 bin 258 dolara indi. Wall Street'teki satış dalgası kriptoyu da vurdu Kripto para piyasasındaki düşüşte ABD borsalarında yaşanan sert satışlar etkili oldu. Ara seçimlerin ardından özellikle teknoloji hisselerinde yoğunlaşan satış baskısı, riskli varlıklara yönelik iştahı zayıflattı. Demokratların ara seçimlerde elde ettiği zafer sonrasında Kongre'de oluşan yeni siyasi dengeler, yapay zeka ve veri merkezi sektörlerine yönelik denetimlerin sıkılaşabileceği endişelerini artırdı. Bu gelişme, teknoloji şirketlerinin hisselerinde satışları derinleştirdi. Gün içinde Dow Jones endeksi 1000 puanın üzerinde değer kaybederek yüzde 3'e yakın geriledi. S&P 500 yüzde 3'ün, Nasdaq ise yüzde 4'ün üzerinde düşüş kaydetti. Kripto düzenlemelerinde belirsizlik artıyor Demokratların Kongre'de çoğunluğu ele geçirmesinin dijital varlık sektörüne yönelik düzenlemelerin geleceği konusunda da belirsizlik yarattığı değerlendiriliyor. Sektörün yakından takip ettiği ve dijital varlıklara yönelik kapsamlı bir düzenleyici çerçeve oluşturmayı amaçlayan CLARITY Act'in Kongre'den geçmesine ilişkin beklentiler de zayıfladı. Düzenlemenin yasalaşmasına yönelik sürecin yıl sonuna kadar ilerleme kaydetmesinin düşük ihtimal olarak görülmesi, kripto piyasasındaki belirsizliği artıran unsurlar arasında yer alıyor.

news.title: California governor commutes death sentences for all 548 people on death row
news.summary: California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates in the US.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: California governor commutes death sentences for all 548 people on death row
news.summaryTr: California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates in the US.
news.articleText: California governor commutes death sentences for all 548 people on death row - Published California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 people on death row in the state, changing them instead with life in prison. "We can now let these offenders die in obscurity while we forever remember and honour the victims," he said in a letter. The decision to spare death row inmates is largely symbolic in a state that has not executed a prisoner since 2006, though experts say it could save millions of dollars in court costs each year. Only 13 inmates have been executed since voters reinstated the death penalty in 1978. The decision comes as Newsom, the Democratic leader of the most populous US state, has been discussed as a possible 2028 contender for president. Newsom, who is term limited, is winding down his final months in office. Fellow Democrat Xavier Becerra is projected to take over after the midterm elections on Tuesday. Newsom explained in his letter that he is exercising his constitutional clemency authority to commute the sentences to life without the possibility of parole. "After nearly 30 years in public office, I have come to understand the limits of what government can justly accomplish," Newsom said. "I take this action because I firmly believe that state-sanctioned killing is incompatible with California's values, undermines the foundations of our legal system and diminishes each of us". California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates. Newsom had previously ordered a halt to the death penalty in the state in 2019. Newsom, describing his decision as a difficult but "righteous action", said that although many Californians feel that those who commit brutal crimes deserve to die, he has concluded that "the state cannot morally kill them". He said that by every measure, California's system for administering the death penalty "is a failure", and that it has not and cannot be fairly applied, resulting in the conviction of innocent people. Life without the possibility of parole is the most severe punishment he can lawfully impose and that the state can ethically enforce, he said. He acknowledged that his clemency action will anger and hurt some Californians and said that it will "always weigh heavily on me". "As Governor, I alone bear responsibility for this decision and its impact, just as I alone would bear responsibility for each execution," he wrote. "For this reason I am compelled to follow my conscience and, as authorised by our Constitution, take this action for the welfare of the State of California." Because individual states have the power to prosecute crimes and order executions, much of the power lies with state governors. The decision comes after the high-profile botched execution of a woman in Tennessee in late September and while executions have been on the rise in the US. On the federal level, President Donald Trump, a long-time supporter of the death penalty, has described capital punishment as "an essential tool for deterring and punishing those who would commit the most heinous crimes and acts of lethal violence against American citizens". In 2020, during his first term, he ended a nearly two-decade moratorium on the federal death penalty, by ordering 13 executions over a six-month period. While the moratorium returned under President Biden, on the first day of Trump's second term in 2025, he signed an executive order that re-instated the death penalty. No federal executions have been carried out since he signed it, however. In the US, both the federal government and local states authorities can order executions. news.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
news.summary: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
news.summaryTr: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.
news.articleText: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel? - Published The warnings came in thick and fast, targeting one airline or airport after another. In nearly all cases - London's Heathrow airport being a notable exception - they were taken to be credible enough to divert the aircraft in question, or even in Italy's case, to scramble fighter jets to escort it. They all turned out to be false, which does not, of course, mean that the next ones will not be real. It is hardly surprising that the simultaneous, co-ordinated nature of these airline hoaxes, coupled with other malicious actions across Europe, are causing some people to point the finger of suspicion at Russia. Following a series of cyber-attacks and mysterious drone sightings over sensitive sites earlier this year, in the past few days we have seen the remote hacking of supermarket freezers, as well as a blood bank, a suspicious incident on Poland's border with Russia, and in August a drone attack Germany's Leipzig Halle airport which its interior minister publicly blamed on Moscow. So is Russia behind this? There are many who argue, based purely on circumstantial evidence, that this must surely be yet another example of "hybrid", "grey zone" or "sub-threshold" warfare - actions that damage a nation's infrastructure or society but which tend to be anonymous, deniable and which fall short of triggering Nato's Article 5 and thereby mobilising a response by the West. Moscow is certainly furious with Nato for supporting Ukraine and, in doing so, frustrating the Kremlin's plans to swallow up that country and effectively terminate its independence. Russian bloggers have also suggested that, if Ukraine's drones are currently making Russia's airports unsafe, and Western sanctions are blocking Russian airlines from European airspace, then why shouldn't Western nations feel the same pain? But as of Thursday evening no hard evidence had emerged linking the airline hoaxes to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups controlled by them. There is the email threat sent on Thursday morning to airport authorities in Rome, purporting to be from "Fighters of the Male State". That name likely refers to the Russian group Muzhskoi Legion or "Male Legion", an ultra-right group with such extreme views it was banned by a Moscow court in 2021. Yet, it retained tens of thousands of online followers on Telegram as it cheered on the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine in the following year. But the email sent to Rome, even if genuine - and who is to say it is not another group hiding behind that name? - is unlikely to provide the leads that police and airport authorities need to pin down who is generating these hoaxes and why. For national police forces, airport authorities and transport ministries trying to work out who is behind these hoaxes and how best to mitigate their effect when they happen again, the task is not to go with who they think might be the most likely culprits but instead to follow the cold, hard leads - if they can find them.

news.titleTr: Fon soruşturması kapsamında sıcak gelişme: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya hakkında tutuklama talebi

news.articleText: Fon soruşturması kapsamında sıcak gelişme: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya hakkında tutuklama talebi YAYIN TARİHİ, 05 Kasım 2026 22:46 GÜNCELLEME, 05 Kasım 2026 23:13 PAYLAŞ - İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı'nın yürüttüğü fon soruşturmasında Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, tutuklama talebiyle mahkemeye sevk edildi. Kaya hakkındaki nihai kararı mahkeme verecek. İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı tarafından yürütülen fon soruşturması kapsamında Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, tutuklama talebiyle mahkemeye sevk edildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Soruşturma kapsamında savcılıktaki işlemleri tamamlanan Kaya hakkında tutuklama talebinde bulunuldu. Mahkemenin, tutuklama talebine ilişkin karar vermesi bekleniyor. Fon soruşturması kapsamında "şüpheli" sıfatıyla ifadesi alınan İlyas Kaya ile eski SPK Başkanı İbrahim Ömer Gönül, haklarında adli kontrol uygulanması talebiyle hakimliğe sevk edildi.

Kaynak, Halkbank aracılığıyla esnaf ve sanatkârlara kullandırılan faiz destekli krediler için kullanılacak. TBMM’de 2027 yılı bütçe görüşmeleri sırasında esnaf ve sanatkârları yakından ilgilendiren önemli bir önerge sunuldu. Önergeyle, Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı bütçesine 33 milyar TL tutarında ilave ödenek eklenmesi teklif edildi. 33 milyar TL Halkbank kredileri için ayrılacak CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Önergenin gerekçesinde, 5570 sayılı Kamu Sermayeli Bankalar Tarafından Yürütülen Faiz Destekli Kredi ve Kâr Payı Destekli Fon Kullandırılmasına Dair Kanun'a atıfta bulunuldu. Buna göre 33 milyar TL'lik ödenek, Türkiye Halk Bankası A.Ş. tarafından esnaf ve sanatkârların finansman ihtiyaçlarının uygun koşullarda karşılanabilmesi amacıyla kullandırılan destekli krediler için Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı bütçesine eklenecek. 2027 bütçesine 33 milyar TL ilave ödenek Önergeye ilişkin cetvelde bütçe bilgileri şöyle sıralandı: - Kurum: Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı - Yıl: 2027 - Program: 17 - Kurumsal kod: 12.40 - Finansman kodu: 01 - Ekonomik kod: 05.01 - Eklenen tutar: 33 milyar TL Önergenin gerekçesinde, ilave ödeneğin esnaf ve sanatkârların finansman ihtiyaçlarının uygun koşullarda karşılanmasını teminen ayrıldığı belirtildi.

news.titleTr: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
news.summaryTr: Victims are found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports.
news.articleText: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey - Published Eight people have been killed and one seriously injured in a series of shootings in western Turkey. The attacks took place in the Afyonkarahisar province on Thursday, with victims found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports. The suspect fled, triggering a manhunt, and authorities later said he had been arrested in Eskişehir province. CCTV footage published in Turkish media showed a man in a black jacket, white trousers and glasses clutching a long weapon as he stood by a red minivan. Turkey's state-run Anadolu Agency reported that three people were killed near Ayazini village and three others near Kiyir village. In Yukaritandir, two women were found injured and later died in hospital. Two teachers were reportedly among the dead. Local media said roads leading to the affected villages were closed by police, while officers launched a large-scale operation to find the suspect. The newspaper Milliyet reported that a vehicle allegedly taken by the attacker had been later found stuck in mud - the suspect having abandoned it before fleeing on foot. In a statement posted on social media, the Afyonkarahisar Governorate said "all relevant institutions of our state have been working in coordination since the very first moment and are meticulously carrying out the necessary work".

news.articleText: Migros, Tofaş, Şişecam... 26 şirketin kâr ve zarar tablosu belli oldu Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 26 şirket, 2026 yılının ilk 9 ayına ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını KAP'a bildirdi. Açıklanan bilançolarda bazı şirketlerin net kârları artarken, bazılarında düşüş ve zarar dikkat çekti. İşte 25 şirketin kâr ve zarar rakamları... Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketler, 2026 yılının ilk 9 ayına ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) bildirmeye devam ediyor. news.title: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials
news.summary: The US first lady was credited by all for playing a key though unspecified role in the ceasefire.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials
news.summaryTr: The US first lady was credited by all for playing a key though unspecified role in the ceasefire.
news.articleText: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials - Published US First Lady Melania Trump called for a "more enduring" ceasefire in Ukraine as she welcomed Russian and Ukrainian delegations at the White House following last week's truce in the southern region of Kherson. Hundreds of residents of the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky facing starvation and constant bombardment were able to evacuate during a six-day ceasefire, which both Moscow and Kyiv credited Trump with brokering. "The lives of innocent people must transcend the division of war. I hope Oleshky inspires greater peace," she said. The unusual White House event saw senior Ukrainian and Russian officials meet away from the setting of official US-brokered peace talks they have been holding without success since last year. The delegations were made up of Ukraine's human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets and his Russian counterpart Yana Lantratova, as well as Ukrainian MP Davyd Arakhamia and Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev. Melania Trump was credited by all for playing a key though unspecified role in the ceasefire, and all parties conveyed to her the gratitude of the Russian and Ukrainian presidents. The US first lady said she had "reviewed demining plans, aerial images, assessed roadways, and discussed evacuation routes, hospital access, vehicles, and medical resources" during the truce. "Last week in Oleshky and neighbouring areas of Kherson, people experienced the simple joys of life for the first time since 2022," Trump said. "They walked down familiar streets without fear of explosions." She thanked both Volodymyr Zelensky and Vladimir Putin, making no reference to the origins of the war, which began when the Russian president launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, and which has caused thousands of civilian casualties and the displacement of millions. Dmitriev, a businessman and Kremlin special envoy who has previously represented Moscow during peace talks with Ukraine, thanked Trump for "saving and touching so many lives". "Let us continue making a humanitarian contribution together; this is within our power," Dmitriev said, before gifting Melania Trump a framed drawing by an 11-year-old Oleshky evacuee. He also praised Trump for her work on reuniting children separated from their families by the war. These include children allegedly abducted by Russia. Arakhamia, a Ukrainian MP who heads Zelensky's party in parliament who has also been part of the Ukrainian negotiating team, said the Oleshky ceasefire had constituted the "biggest de-escalation since 2022". "We are creating a momentum where both sides are learning the… mechanics of how to actually keep the peace when the peace comes," he added. He acknowledged that the "political track" of negotiations to end the conflict was "complex" but said Ukrainians were asking Melania Trump "to keep going and find new missions and de-escalate more." At the end of the event, Trump handed Dmitriev and Arakhamia two letters to be hand-delivered to their respective presidents. The White House later said Melania Trump had invited her guests to view two historic artifacts which she had "personally selected as powerful symbols of peace". One was an 18th Century medicine chest which was removed from the White House when the British set it on fire in 1812. "Once adversaries, the United States and Great Britain ultimately established a strong alliance," the White House said. The second artifact was a cup gifted in 1899 to the French ambassador in recognition of his efforts to bring the Spanish-American war to an end. Melania Trump has generally remained discreet on foreign policy matters, and neither Moscow nor Kyiv have elaborated on the nature or extent of her involvement in coordinating the delicate ceasefire - the most enduring and widespread of the war so far. A source who works in the local government of the Kherson region told the BBC that work on the Oleshky evacuation had been ongoing for almost a year. However, the source said, "at a certain point other individuals became involved, seemingly after most of the groundwork had already been laid and subsequently began taking credit for the progress that had been made." It was difficult to determine exactly who had played what role and at which stage of the process, the source acknowledged, adding that "those who had been directly involved in the negotiations for nearly a year were eventually prohibited from communicating publicly about the matter." Speaking after the meeting in the White House had taken place, President Zelensky said the success of the Oleshky ceasefire "had proved a very simple thing: when Putin wants the fighting to stop, it stops." "The same applies to our people who are held in Russian captivity. When Putin wants, they go home." A source close to American officials shared a similar assessment, implying to the BBC that despite the outward praise, "the person who made [the ceasefire] possible, whether we like it or not, is essentially Putin." "And this was done in order to pass the ball to [Donald] Trump... so that it would have some positive effect for his midterm elections." There has been no change whatsoever in Russia's position, Ukrainian political analyst Dmytro Levus told the BBC. Moscow "agreed to it because there was pressure from the American side... In doing so, the Russians confirmed Zelenskyy's words that, when necessary, it turns out Russia can quickly stop firing and even maintain that ceasefire." As the frontline region of Kherson experienced its first six days of peace in several years, the rest of Ukraine continued to come under Russian attack. This week, several drone and missile attacks killed and injured civilians across the country. On Monday alone, more than 40 people were killed in a single Russian strike on an aid distribution centre in the region of Zaporizhzhia. More are thought to still be buried under the rubble. Additional reporting by Anastasiia Levchenko in Kyiv

news.summaryTr: Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, fon soruşturmasında listelerin açıklanmasını şahsen istediğini belirtti. Şimşek, bilgiye dayalı çıkışların tespit edilmesi halinde suç duyurusunda bulunulduğunu ve soruşturmada kimseye taviz verilmeyeceğini söyledi.
news.articleText: Bakan Mehmet Şimşek'ten fon soruşturmasında dikkat çeken çıkış: Listeler açıklansın - Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, fon soruşturmasında listelerin açıklanmasını şahsen istediğini belirtti. Şimşek, bilgiye dayalı çıkışların tespit edilmesi halinde suç duyurusunda bulunulduğunu ve soruşturmada kimseye taviz verilmeyeceğini söyledi. Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisi'nde (TBMM) milletvekillerinin sorularını yanıtladı. Şimşek, sermaye piyasalarında yaşanan gelişmeler, fon soruşturması, Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu'nun (SPK) yetkileri ve Mali Suçları Araştırma Kurulu'nun (MASAK) süreçteki rolüne ilişkin açıklamalarda bulundu. "Listelerin açıklanmasını şahsen isterim" CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Fon soruşturması kapsamında gerçekleştirilen çıkışlara ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Şimşek, çıkışların bilgiye dayandığının belirlenmesi halinde ilgililer hakkında suç duyurusunda bulunduklarını söyledi. Listelerin kamuoyuyla paylaşılmasına ilişkin de konuşan Şimşek, "Listelerin açıklanmasında engel yok, ben şahsen açıklanmasını isterim." ifadelerini kullandı. "Hazine'nin 1 kuruşu tasfiyede kullanılmadı" Fonların tasfiye sürecine ilişkin açıklamalarda bulunan Şimşek, tasfiye işlemlerinde Hazine kaynaklarının kullanılmadığını belirtti. Şimşek, "Hazine'nin 1 kuruşu tasfiyede kullanılmadı." dedi. "İhmali ve suistimali olan varsa hesap verecektir" Fon soruşturmasında ihmali veya suistimali bulunanların hesap vereceğini belirten Şimşek, "Bu süreçte ihmali ve suistimali olan varsa hesap verecektir. Vermeye başladılar." ifadelerini kullandı. Daha önce görev yapan SPK başkanlarıyla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldığını aktaran Şimşek, önceki başkan hakkında soruşturma izni verildiğini söyledi. Şimşek, fon soruşturmasında kim olursa olsun hiçbir şekilde taviz verilmeyeceğini vurguladı. news.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
news.summary: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
news.summaryTr: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.
news.articleText: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks. US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance hack, as cybersecurity experts raised concerns about how financial institutions handle crypto-related security risks. Officials from the Federal Reserve and Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) began contacting banks on Monday to ask about “unusual activity” or service disruptions, Reuters reported Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter. The reported inquiries could be followed by closer attention to how banks manage crypto-related risks, including custody, counterparty exposure and incident response, according to Stefan Muehlbauer, head of US government affairs at CertiK. “After an incident of this scale, it would be surprising if the Fed and OCC didn’t check in with the banks they supervise,” Muehlbauer told Cointelegraph. “Their mandate is to protect the financial system, and that means understanding where exposures sit and how quickly they can respond.” Banks review security systems after Binance hack According to Reuters, banks have been assessing the hack and checking their systems to figure out whether they could absorb or manage similar threats. Reuters’ report also noted that a cybersecurity team at one of the largest US banks contacted Binance within hours of the hack. A Binance spokesperson confirmed with Cointelegraph that the exchange shared its publicly released incident report with all its banking partners and was not aware of any vulnerabilities affecting them. Muehlbauer explained the procedure currently unfolding is “how a maturing framework should work.” He added that “it’s not a signal that regulators are pulling back from the industry.” The inquiries also come after the Federal Reserve removed a requirement in April 2025 for state member banks to notify regulators before engaging in crypto activities. The Fed said it would continue overseeing those activities through its regular supervisory process. A Federal Reserve spokesperson told Cointelegraph that the agency had nothing to share regarding the reported inquiries. Cointelegraph also contacted the OCC for comment but has not heard back at the time of publishing. Related: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool The largest crypto hack raises concerns Binance said in its Nov. 3 incident report that approximately $6.34 billion in digital assets were affected by the attack on Oct. 29, with $2.85 billion frozen or intercepted as of the report. According to the crypto exchange, the attack began with compromised software installed by an engineer in June. Hackers later employed social engineering, stolen credentials and malicious software to get access to wallet systems and carry out unauthorized transfers. Dr. Darren Williams, founder and CEO of cybersecurity firm BlackFog, told Cointelegraph that the methods used in the attack pose potential risks to traditional banks, particularly those offering crypto custody and payment services. “Attackers no longer need to break encryption or steal private keys if they can compromise the trusted systems and people authorized to move money,” Williams said. He warned that hackers could use compromised employee devices, accounts or third-party services to move money without triggering any alerts. He also said the growing use of agentic AI in financial operations could pose even more risks. “The priority must be stopping unauthorized transactions and data exfiltration before assets or sensitive information leave the organization, not simply investigating the damage afterwards,” Williams said. Binance has since said that it has strengthened its security controls and was bringing in independent cybersecurity experts to review the attack. Magazine: Binance hackers raced to move billions before it could be frozen

news.title: Şimşek’ten borç yapılandırması mesajı: Faiz konusunda radikal adım gündemde
news.summary: Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, borç yapılandırması için 705 bin kişinin 531,1 milyar TL’lik borçla başvurduğunu açıkladı. Şimşek, aflara karşı olduğunu belirtirken faiz konusunda radikal bir yaklaşımın değerlendirileceğini söyledi.

news.summaryTr: Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, borç yapılandırması için 705 bin kişinin 531,1 milyar TL’lik borçla başvurduğunu açıkladı. Şimşek, aflara karşı olduğunu belirtirken faiz konusunda radikal bir yaklaşımın değerlendirileceğini söyledi.
news.articleText: Şimşek’ten borç yapılandırması mesajı: Faiz konusunda radikal adım gündemde - Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, borç yapılandırması için 705 bin kişinin 531,1 milyar TL’lik borçla başvurduğunu açıkladı. Şimşek, aflara karşı olduğunu belirtirken faiz konusunda radikal bir yaklaşımın değerlendirileceğini söyledi. Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek, TBMM’deki Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı bütçe görüşmelerinde milletvekillerinin sorularını yanıtladı. Borç yapılandırmasına yönelik taleplerin hem Cumhur İttifakı’ndan hem de muhalefetten geldiğini belirten Şimşek, faiz oranlarında ve yapılandırma koşullarında yeni bir yaklaşım üzerinde çalışılabileceğinin sinyalini verdi. 705 bin kişi yapılandırma için başvurdu CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şimşek, borç yapılandırması kapsamında 705 bin kişinin toplam 531,1 milyar TL tutarındaki borcu için başvuru yaptığını açıkladı. Yapılandırmada faizin yüzde 39’a indirildiğini belirten Şimşek, bugüne kadar 31,6 milyar TL tahsilat gerçekleştirildiğini söyledi. “Afları doğru bulmuyorum” Borçların yapılandırılmasına yönelik taleplere değinen Şimşek, vergi ve borç aflarına karşı olduğunu ifade etti. Teminat konusunun büyük ölçüde çözüldüğünü belirten Şimşek, 10 milyon TL’ye kadar teminat aranmadığını ve 72 aya varan vade imkânının bulunduğunu söyledi. Şimşek, geriye faiz konusunun kaldığına dikkat çekti. Faiz konusunda radikal yaklaşım gündemde Şimşek, yapılandırma uygulamasında 72 aylık vadenin etkin biçimde uygulanması gerektiğini belirterek faiz konusunda daha radikal bir yaklaşımın değerlendirilebileceğini söyledi. Şimşek, “72 ayı uygulamada irade koyalım, faiz konusunda radikal bir yaklaşım içine girelim, bu konuyu çalışacağız” ifadelerini kullandı.

news.titleTr: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
news.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul’da 5 Kasım’da 11 şirket yeni iş ilişkisi, sözleşme, yatırım, varlık satışı ve ihale gelişmelerini duyurdu. Açıklamalarda milyonlarca dolarlık ve milyarlarca liralık işlemler öne çıktı.
news.articleText: Borsa İstanbul’da 11 şirketten KAP açıklaması: Milyarlık anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar Borsa İstanbul’da 5 Kasım’da 11 şirket yeni iş ilişkisi, sözleşme, yatırım, varlık satışı ve ihale gelişmelerini duyurdu. Açıklamalarda milyonlarca dolarlık ve milyarlarca liralık işlemler öne çıktı. Doğuş Otomotiv (DOAS) – Skoda ile Irak için iş birliği adımı Doğuş Otomotiv, Skoda Auto A.S. ile Irak’ta Skoda markalı binek otomobillerin satış ve satış sonrası servis hizmetlerini üstlenmek amacıyla niyet mektubu imzaladı. Taraflar arasında nihai anlaşmanın yapılması için önemli bir adım atıldı. Doğu Aras Enerji (ARASE) – 500 milyon TL’lik enerji satış anlaşması Şirketin bağlı ortaklığı Aras Elektrik Perakende Satış A.Ş., Kasım 2026 dönemi için toplam 156 bin MWh enerji satış anlaşması yaptı. Anlaşmanın KDV hariç tutarı 500 milyon TL olarak açıklandı. Tutarın piyasa fiyatlarına göre değişebileceği belirtildi. Meka Global (MEKAG) – Suriye’de distribütörlük anlaşması Meka Global’in yüzde 100 bağlı ortaklığı Meka İthalat İhracat Pazarlama ve Ticaret A.Ş., Suriye’de faaliyet gösteren bir şirketle ürün satışına yönelik distribütörlük sözleşmesi imzaladı. Girişim Elektrik (GESAN) – 2,5 milyon dolarlık sözleşme Girişim Elektrik, Kahramanmaraş’ta gerçekleştirilecek Depolamalı Güneş Enerjisi Santrali projesinin enerji iletim hattı yapım işi için yurt içindeki bir müşteriyle 2,5 milyon dolar bedelli sözleşme imzaladı. Alcatel Lucent Teletaş (ALCTL) – 5,9 milyon dolarlık iş emri Alcatel Lucent Teletaş, Türkiye’de yerleşik bir müşteriyle devam eden iş ilişkisi kapsamında 5 milyon 896 bin 30 dolar tutarında iş emri imzaladığını duyurdu. Europower Enerji (EUPWR) – 1,13 milyar TL’lik TEİAŞ sözleşmesi Europower Enerji’nin yüzde 49 oranında ortak olduğu Euroes Teknoloji ve Taahhüt A.Ş., TEİAŞ’ın Konya Kuzey–IGA GES enerji iletim hattı yapım ihalesinde en avantajlı teklifi vermişti. Şirkete iletilen sözleşme davetinin ardından taraflar sözleşmeyi imzaladı. Sözleşmenin baz bedeli 1 milyar 133 milyon 133 bin 133 TL oldu. Anadolu Sigorta (ANSGR) – Brüt prim üretimi yüzde 18,5 arttı Anadolu Sigorta’nın 1 Ocak–31 Ekim 2026 dönemindeki bağımsız denetimden geçmemiş brüt prim üretimi 88 milyar 568 milyon 746 bin 439 TL’ye ulaştı. Böylece brüt prim üretimi geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 18,5 artış gösterdi. Hun Yenilenebilir Enerji (HUNER) – Letonya’ya 6 milyon euroluk enerji depolama yatırımı Hun Yenilenebilir Enerji’nin yüzde 60 payını devraldığı Letonya merkezli SW Electricity SIA’nın Riga’da geliştirdiği yaklaşık 15 MW/30 MWh kapasiteli bataryalı enerji depolama projesinin inşaatına 2027 yılında başlanması planlanıyor. Projenin toplam yatırım tutarının yaklaşık 6 milyon euro olması bekleniyor. Finansman için Letonya’daki bankalardan teklifler alınırken kredi koşullarına ilişkin görüşmeler sürüyor. Gelecek Varlık Yönetimi (GLCVY) – 445,7 milyon TL’lik portföy ihalesi Gelecek Varlık Yönetimi, Fibabanka’nın 5 Kasım’da gerçekleştirdiği tahsili gecikmiş alacak satışında, 445,7 milyon TL anapara büyüklüğündeki bireysel portföyün ihalesini kazandı. İhale sonucunun kesinleşmesi için Fibabanka Yönetim Kurulu’nun onayı gerekiyor. Skyalp Finansal Teknolojiler (SKYLP) – 70,4 milyon TL’lik pay devri Skyalp Finansal Teknolojiler, iştiraki Tenk Bilişim Teknolojileri Danışmanlık A.Ş.’de sahip olduğu ve şirket sermayesinin yüzde 3,81’ine karşılık gelen 1 milyon 253 bin 122 adet payı, Hedef Portföy Gelişim Girişim Sermayesi Yatırım Fonu’na devretme kararı aldı. Pay devri için 70 milyon 387 bin TL bedel üzerinden sözleşme imzalandı. Gelirin Borsa Para Piyasası borçlarının ödenmesi ve işletme sermayesinde kullanılması planlanıyor. Deniz Gayrimenkul Yatırım Ortaklığı (DZGYO) – Bodrum’daki otel 979,4 milyon TL’ye satıldı Deniz Gayrimenkul Yatırım Ortaklığı, Bodrum’un Eskiçeşme Mahallesi’nde bulunan otel binasını KDV hariç 979 milyon 364 bin TL bedelle sattı. Gayrimenkulün ekspertiz değeri 968 milyon 700 bin TL olarak açıklanmıştı. Satış bedelinin 13 Kasım 2026 tarihinde tahsil edilmesi bekleniyor.

news.title: Paraguay’da bankacılık krizi hükümeti devirdi: Devlet Başkanı Pena istifa etti
news.summary: Paraguay’da yaklaşık 3 milyon müşterinin banka hesaplarına erişimini kaybetmesine yol açan Ueno krizinin ardından siyasi baskılar arttı. Devlet Başkanı Santiago Pena istifa ederken, Meclis’in azil sürecini onayladığı bildirildi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Paraguay’da bankacılık krizi hükümeti devirdi: Devlet Başkanı Pena istifa etti
news.summaryTr: Paraguay’da yaklaşık 3 milyon müşterinin banka hesaplarına erişimini kaybetmesine yol açan Ueno krizinin ardından siyasi baskılar arttı. Devlet Başkanı Santiago Pena istifa ederken, Meclis’in azil sürecini onayladığı bildirildi.
news.articleText: Paraguay’da bankacılık krizi hükümeti devirdi: Devlet Başkanı Pena istifa etti - Paraguay’da yaklaşık 3 milyon müşterinin banka hesaplarına erişimini kaybetmesine yol açan Ueno krizinin ardından siyasi baskılar arttı. Devlet Başkanı Santiago Pena istifa ederken, Meclis’in azil sürecini onayladığı bildirildi. Paraguay’da dijital banka Ueno’nun çöküşüyle başlayan bankacılık krizi, ülkenin siyasi yönetimini de sarstı. Devlet Başkanı Santiago Pena, bankanın faaliyetlerinin durması ve milyonlarca müşterinin hesaplarına erişememesi üzerine artan siyasi baskılar nedeniyle Perşembe günü görevinden istifa etti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Pena, yayımladığı video mesajında ülkenin istikrarını, toplumsal barışı ve demokratik kurumları koruma gerekliliğini göz önünde bulundurarak istifa kararı aldığını açıkladı. Bloomberg’in haberine göre Paraguay Meclisi, Pena’nın azledilmesini onayladı. İstifanın resmiyet kazanması için Senato’nun da kararı kabul etmesi gerekiyor. Ueno krizi 3 milyon müşteriyi etkiledi Yaklaşık 6,5 milyon nüfuslu Paraguay’da Ueno’nun faaliyetlerinin durdurulması, yaklaşık 3 milyon müşterinin banka hesaplarına erişememesine yol açtı. Ülke nüfusunun neredeyse yarısını etkileyen kriz, hükümet üzerindeki baskıyı artırdı. Paraguay Merkez Bankası, Ueno’nun asgari sermaye yeterliliği koşullarını ihlal ettiğini tespit etmesinin ardından bankaya el koydu. Başlangıçta sınırlı ölçekte faaliyet gösteren bir finansal teknoloji şirketi olan Ueno, hızlı büyümesinin ardından yaklaşık 850 milyon dolarlık kamu fonunu yöneten orta ölçekli bir bankaya dönüşmüştü. Kriz kapsamında Paraguay Merkez Bankası Başkanı da Salı günü istifa etti. Bankanın sekiz yöneticisi ise gözaltına alındı. Pena’ya çıkar çatışması ve usulsüzlük suçlamaları Muhalefet milletvekilleri, Pena’yı Ueno kriziyle bağlantılı olarak çıkar çatışması, emeklilik fonlarının kötüye kullanılması ve kurumsal usulsüzlüklerin örtbas edilmesiyle suçladı. Pena’nın geçmişte Ueno ile iş bağlantılarının bulunması da tartışmaların odağında yer aldı. Protestocular devlet başkanının istifasını talep ederken, muhalefet partileri azil sürecini başlatmak amacıyla Kongre’de olağanüstü oturum çağrısı yaptı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump’ın müttefiklerinden biri olarak bilinen Pena, kendi muhafazakâr partisinden bazı üyelerin desteğini de kaybetti. Pena, istifa açıklamasında kamu fonlarının ve Paraguay halkına ait kaynakların korunması gerektiğini vurguladı. Ayrıca mevduat garanti fonunun görevini yerine getirmesini ve fonların geri ödenmesinin güvence altına alınmasını istedi. Yeni devlet başkanı Pedro Alliana olacak Pena’nın istifasının Senato tarafından resmen kabul edilmesi bekleniyor. Kongre'nin istifayı görüşmek üzere yerel saatle 14.00'te toplanacağı bildirildi. Devlet Başkan Yardımcısı Pedro Alliana’nın ise yerel saatle 15.30 civarında yemin ederek görevi devralması bekleniyor. Bankacılık krizinin siyasi sonuçlarının yanı sıra Paraguay’ın, özellikle komşusu Brezilya başta olmak üzere yabancı yatırımcılar nezdindeki istikrarlı yatırım merkezi imajına da zarar verdiği değerlendiriliyor.

Ueno krizi 3 milyon müşteriyi etkiledi Yaklaşık 6,5 milyon nüfuslu Paraguay’da Ueno’nun faaliyetlerinin durdurulması, yaklaşık 3 milyon müşterinin banka hesaplarına erişememesine yol açtı. Ülke nüfusunun neredeyse yarısını etkileyen kriz, hükümet üzerindeki baskıyı artırdı. Paraguay Merkez Bankası, Ueno’nun asgari sermaye yeterliliği koşullarını ihlal ettiğini tespit etmesinin ardından bankaya el koydu. Başlangıçta sınırlı ölçekte faaliyet gösteren bir finansal teknoloji şirketi olan Ueno, hızlı büyümesinin ardından yaklaşık 850 milyon dolarlık kamu fonunu yöneten orta ölçekli bir bankaya dönüşmüştü. Kriz kapsamında Paraguay Merkez Bankası Başkanı da Salı günü istifa etti. Bankanın sekiz yöneticisi ise gözaltına alındı. Pena’ya çıkar çatışması ve usulsüzlük suçlamaları Muhalefet milletvekilleri, Pena’yı Ueno kriziyle bağlantılı olarak çıkar çatışması, emeklilik fonlarının kötüye kullanılması ve kurumsal usulsüzlüklerin örtbas edilmesiyle suçladı. Ayrıca mevduat garanti fonunun görevini yerine getirmesini ve fonların geri ödenmesinin güvence altına alınmasını istedi. Yeni devlet başkanı Pedro Alliana olacak Pena’nın istifasının Senato tarafından resmen kabul edilmesi bekleniyor. Kongre'nin istifayı görüşmek üzere yerel saatle 14.00'te toplanacağı bildirildi. Devlet Başkan Yardımcısı Pedro Alliana’nın ise yerel saatle 15.30 civarında yemin ederek görevi devralması bekleniyor. Bankacılık krizinin siyasi sonuçlarının yanı sıra Paraguay’ın, özellikle komşusu Brezilya başta olmak üzere yabancı yatırımcılar nezdindeki istikrarlı yatırım merkezi imajına da zarar verdiği değerlendiriliyor.

news.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
news.summary: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.
